people.imagined: Early morning at the mouth of an eastern pass; he leans on a spear, shifting weight off the bad leg so it will not show, and squints at the sun.
people.subject: The moment: early morning at the mouth of an eastern pass; he leans on a plain ash spear, shifting his weight off the bad leg so it will not show on level ground, and squints at the low sun, then at the viewer, the way a man looks at a client he already doubts. Face: a lean, brown, long-jawed face of forty with a permanent mine-guard's squint, the eyes narrowed to slits ringed with fine white lines; a thin scar through the left brow; a clipped dark moustache; a calm weathered mouth that gives nothing away; dry cracked lips. Hair: black, close-cropped and greying at the sides, with a stubble of the same grey on his jaw. Body: lean and wiry, one hip dropped to favour the left leg, the right shoulder carrying a rope coil. Clothing: hunters' leathers of forest-brown hide over a linen shirt with a rolled neck; a short quilted jerkin; a flat leather map case on a strap across his chest; a sword on his hip with a crossguard carrying only three small filed notches, as he has found no cave; wrapped leg-bindings; worn boots. Hands and objects: the right fist closed round the shaft of the spear, an old Pavilion mine-guard's weapon with a black-stained tip; the left hand holds the strap of the map case. Background: a stony pass with a few larches, thin mist in the valley, a cairn of stones. Light: low cool morning light from the upper left, long shadows. Expression: calm, pragmatic and unreadable; a man who walked off a post once and has never explained it.

people.imagined: At the map wall with a stick of chalk, one eye screwed shut, and he has just found a small wrong turn that was not there yesterday.
people.subject: The moment: at the map wall in the lodge by lamplight; he has found a small wrong turn that was not drawn yesterday, one eye screwed shut as it always is when he reads, and turns to glare suspiciously at the viewer. Face: a narrow, sallow, suspicious face of thirty-five; the left eye tightly shut and the right wide and pale; a long nose; a thin lip; a white chalk smudge on the cheek; sparse patchy beard; a vertical line between the brows. Hair: dark, tied up in a messy knot with a bit of chalk-stained string. Body: thin, stooped and narrow-shouldered, standing very close to the wall. Clothing: brown leathers and a linen shirt, sleeves rolled to the elbow; a hunter's jerkin; both forearms white with chalk to the elbow, plainly shown; a leather apron with a pocket of chalk sticks; soft boots. Hands and objects: a stub of white chalk in his right hand held like a dagger; the left hand spread flat on a wall of inked lines (no readable writing), the fingers white. Background: a plank wall covered with a dense web of drawn lines, notches and small pale crosses, a ladder, a second lamp on a hook. Light: lamplight from the upper left, deep shadows, chalk dust glinting. Expression: paranoid, careful and sly; he is testing who copies him.

people.imagined: Dawn drill in the yard; he has lost the place in the Pavilion's breathing primer and stands with his mouth slightly open, hair parted like a Băng Tâm boy.
people.subject: The moment: a cold dawn drill in the lodge yard; he has lost his place in the Pavilion's breathing primer, as he does every morning, and gazes vaguely past the viewer with a practice sword hanging low in his hand. Face: a pale, earnest, long face of twenty; soft pale-grey eyes unfocused; fine pale brows; a slightly open mouth; frost-pink at the nose and ears; a faint blue vein at the temple; his knuckles are red with cold and his breath makes a small cloud. Hair: dark, parted exactly in the centre as the Pavilion parts it, tied in a neat low knot. Body: tall, thin and stiff, standing too upright for a hunter; a fold of white linen at the neck is slightly crooked. Clothing: hunters' leathers in forest brown, clean, over a linen shirt, a short jerkin; and an undyed white linen collar peeking at the neck from his old Pavilion habit, folded in the Pavilion's neat way; hide leggings; boots. Hands and objects: a plain practice sword hanging point down in his right hand; the left hand open and curled, still in the primer's hand-seat. Background: a cold yard with a timber wall, frosted ground, breath hanging in the air, a pair of hunters sparring blurred behind. Light: pale dawn from the upper left. Expression: humble, absent and stubborn.

people.imagined: On the ice stair, cutting a step; he looks back over his shoulder with a calm and a lie ready.
people.subject: The moment: on the blue ice stair of the high peak, crouched with a pick, cutting a new step; he looks back over his shoulder at the viewer with a calm face and a lie ready. Face: a square, rugged face of twenty-two with rock dust in the lines; steady grey eyes; thick brows; a sly curl at one corner of the mouth; wind-burnt cheeks; a split in the lower lip; his boots are wet and the stitching on one has split. Hair: brown, short and dusty with a few specks of ice. Body: broad-shouldered with a pickaxe-swinging walk, crouched low on the stair, one knee on a step; a fresh pale chip of ice lies on his shoulder. Clothing: brown leathers and linen, a quilted jerkin with ice on it, a rope round the waist, crampon-like iron spikes strapped to his boots; hide mittens tucked in the belt. Hands and objects: a short miner's pick in the right hand; palms grey with rock dust; a coil of rope over the shoulder. Background: blue-white ice steps climbing, a dark crevice beside the stair, mist; behind him a line of cut steps shows each one angled a little to the left of the old route. Light: cold bright light from the upper left, a blue glint from the ice. Expression: brave, patient and deceitful; a man who points the steps toward a guess of his own.

people.imagined: Being told he is trusted; his ears go red; the satchel strap is worn through.
people.subject: The moment: he has just been told he is trusted, his ears have gone red, and he stands with a worn satchel held to his chest, beaming at the viewer. Face: a bright, frank, boyish face of sixteen; wide open hazel eyes; a gap-toothed grin; ears sticking out and flaming red; freckles across the nose; a fresh scratch on the cheek; his bare feet are brown and scratched, his toes gripping the ground. Hair: tousled brown with a feather stuck in it; a long green feather stuck in his hair is from the oriole valley. Body: wiry, half-wild, restless on his feet. Clothing: clean forest-brown hunter's jerkin; a green wool shirt; hide trousers with sinew-stitched knees; barefoot, or in rough hide moccasins; a satchel with a strap worn nearly through. Hands and objects: both hands clutch the satchel's worn strap at his chest; a single copper coin is visible in his palm; the satchel is stuffed with rolled sheets tied with twine (no writing visible) and its flap is held by a bone button. Background: a green valley edge, birch trees, a stream; behind him a thin track winds down the valley toward the roofs of a town; he rocks on his heels as if about to run with a message. Light: warm bright light from the upper left. Expression: trusting, proud and happy; he does not know what is in the satchel.

people.imagined: Resting on a rock with a load beside him, counting a belt of knotted cords with a worried frown.
people.subject: The moment: resting on a boulder beside the trail with a pack load beside him, fingering a belt of knotted cords with a worried frown, he looks up at the viewer content but a little nervous. Face: a thick-necked, round, easy face of thirty-five with a double chin; small content eyes; heavy lids; stubble; a soft mouth with a bitten lip; a sunburnt nose; the head-strap has worn a pale band into his forehead. Hair: short brown, thin on top; beside him the load basket is tied with a red cord and a half-eaten bread bun lies on a cloth. Body: heavy, thick porter's neck, broad shoulders, sitting with knees apart. Clothing: brown leathers, a heavy quilted jerkin, bare forearms, a porter's head-strap round his brow; a worn blue cloth under the strap; hide boots with one boot missing a lace; the knots on the belt are in clusters of three, one thumb resting on the biggest. Hands and objects: a belt of knotted cords counted bead by bead in his big hands; a huge load basket beside him with a bundle of rolled blankets; a small basket of mushrooms covered with a cloth on top; a smaller man's pack stands unattended at the other side, and he has slid his own wage pouch under his thigh. Background: a mountain path, rocks, larches, a cold stream. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: loyal, lazy and content; slightly nervous at the count.

people.imagined: Dawn in the sword yard after a bout; fresh-shaven jaw over the old scar, sword resting on the shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: dawn in the sword yard after a bout with the guest teacher; fresh-shaven jaw over an old scar; he stands with a sword on his shoulder and looks coldly at the viewer. Face: a hard, handsome, freshly shaved face of thirty; a pale old scar running along the jaw under the shave, plain; cold bright eyes; thin sharp brows; a thin mouth; a nick from the razor on the chin; behind him on the packed earth a boy sits clutching his bandaged right hand, face turned away; the morning breath hangs in white clouds; he has a tiny drop of blood on his collar where the razor nicked him, and the new scar-white line on his jaw glints in the light. Hair: black, neatly tied, a plain cord. Body: lean, trained and upright, feet planted. Clothing: well-cut forest-brown leathers with a clean linen shirt, buckled bracers on both forearms, a short jerkin; tied leggings; polished boots; his left hand rests on his hip with the thumb hooked in the belt. Hands and objects: a sword with a notch-filed crossguard rests on the shoulder; the right hand holds it loosely; a wooden practice blade lies in the dust at his feet; his bracer's leather is polished dark and his sword's pommel is bound with white cord. Background: a timber sword yard, a rack of practice swords, a boy with a broken hand blurred at the edge. Light: pale dawn from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, cruel and loyal to one man.

people.imagined: Evening at the map wall in the lodge; he has just filed the 413th notch into the guard and holds the sword up to his eye.
people.subject: The moment: evening in the lodge at the map wall; he has just filed the 413th notch into his sword's guard and raises the sword so the notched guard is level with his eye, looking past it at the viewer. Face: a lean, sharp-featured face of thirty; high cheekbones; a long straight nose; intense dark eyes under heavy brows; a thin mouth set; stubble; fine filing dust on his lashes; his eyes narrow along the notched guard as if counting. Hair: black, tied up high with a leather thong. Body: lean and rangy, upright. Clothing: a deer-hide coat with fine ink lines of caves on the lining showing at the open front, over a clean linen shirt; hunter's leathers; a quilted jerkin; a map case; tall boots; his shirt cuffs are rolled with a thin scatter of steel dust on the forearms. Hands and objects: a plain hunter's sword with the crossguard filed with hundreds of small notches in a clear row, big and plain, held up before his face; a small file in the left hand; a small round hunter's lamp sits on a table below, and wood-shavings from the guard curl on the sill; his left thumb rests on the blade's flat. Background: a wall of ink maps in lamplight, a hundred small crosses; on the map wall behind him all but one of the pale cave crosses are struck through with a single black line. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Expression: stubborn, ambitious and brave; a boy turned away from a gate.

people.imagined: Evening, a cup of wine in his left hand so that his right stays steady; tall, grey, well dressed, going to seed.
people.subject: The moment: evening in the lodge; he sits at a table with a wine cup in his left hand so that his right stays steady, and looks at the viewer with weary arrogance. Face: a long, handsome, ravaged face of fifty; grey stubble; pouched dark eyes; a fine long nose with broken veins; the corners of the mouth turned down; deep nasolabial lines; the cuff of his left sleeve has a brown stain the shape of a leaf; a faint smile pulls one cheek, there and gone. Hair: silver-grey, long, swept back and tied with a silk cord. Body: tall, lean, once very fit, now relaxed in the chair; the scabbard at his knee is black lacquer with a worn silver chape. Clothing: a finely cut grey brocade-trimmed hunter's coat of expensive dark leather and a good grey silk shirt, well made though wine-stained at one cuff; no ornament; soft fine boots. Hands and objects: a cup in the left hand; the right hand lying open and perfectly still on the table; a sword in a black scabbard leaning at his knee; a second empty cup stands on the table and a jug of dark wine, half drunk; his fingers on the table are long and fine and do not tremble at all; the lamp throws his tall shadow across the wall of maps. Background: a dim lodge corner, a lamp, a shelf of cups. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Expression: arrogant, lazy and vengeful underneath.

people.imagined: Spring morning at the hermitage gate, shrugging the basket of larch mushrooms off his back and smiling.
people.subject: The moment: spring morning at the hermitage gate; he shrugs a basket of larch mushrooms off his back and smiles at the viewer, as he has every spring for thirty years. Face: a cheerful, bow-legged mountain guide's face of forty, round and brown; crinkled bright eyes; a gap in the teeth; a stubbly chin; sunburn peeling at the nose; his basket has an old patch of birch-bark at the bottom, and a few mushroom caps spill over the rim, pale gold with brown scales. Hair: brown, short, a green headband. Body: short, stocky, bow-legged stance, the shoulders broad from carrying; his legs are bowed so far that daylight shows between his knees. Clothing: forest-brown leathers, a quilted jerkin; a cord belt; a sword on his hip; rope coiled on one shoulder; hide leggings; his boots are muddy to the ankle from the spring thaw. Hands and objects: a tall woven basket heaped with pale larch mushrooms, tipped down from his back; his thumb is wedged under a strap; far behind him a thin grey figure at the stone gate raises one hand in return. Background: a larch wood, a stone gate far behind, sunlit branches; the straps have worn a polished groove in his leather jerkin; a sprig of larch is stuck behind his ear, with soft green needles. Light: bright spring light from the upper left. Expression: patient, loyal and warm.

people.imagined: Teaching the outer gate in the cold yard; he sits as a Pavilion disciple and resents it.
people.subject: The moment: teaching the outer gate in the cold yard; he sits upright on a log exactly like a Pavilion disciple and scowls at the viewer, annoyed at himself for it. Face: a stiff, carefully composed square face of forty; heavy brows tight; angry grey eyes; pale skin; clean-shaven; a hard mouth; a thin vein at the temple; his log is slick with frost and his breath makes a straight vertical plume because he sits so exactly; the scarf's fold is a perfect triangle, and he tugs it a fraction straighter without noticing. Hair: black, parted in the middle exactly as the Pavilion parts it, tied in a low knot. Body: rigid and upright, the spine as if on a pole. Clothing: hunters' leathers in moss green over plain linen, a grey scarf folded in the Pavilion's neat way; a quilted jerkin; wrapped leggings; boots with iron cleats. Hands and objects: both hands rest flat on his knees, the fingers precisely aligned; a practice sword lies across the log beside him; his hands are chapped and white at the knuckles, and the practice sword's grip is bound in new green cord. Background: a cold yard, breath-mist, a few outer-gate boys drilling blurred behind; behind him a row of outer-gate boys sit slouched in a line and he has just corrected one with a sharp word. Light: pale light from the upper left. Expression: wrathful, diligent and arbitrary.

people.imagined: On a narrow ice stair, holding a worn bead string and looking down steadily at the climbers behind.
people.subject: The moment: on a narrow ice stair; he looks down toward the viewer and extends a roped hand to help a climber up. Face: a weathered, still face of forty-five; deep lines; narrow pale eyes; a thin white-flecked beard; a patient mouth; a few frost crystals cling to his beard and the lashes of his narrow eyes; behind him a drop of misty air shows the valley far below, and a second climber's glove is just reaching into the frame. Hair: grey and brown, cropped. Body: wiry, strong and steady, standing sure-footed on ice. Clothing: dark hunters' leathers, a quilted jerkin, a rope at the waist; iron spikes bound over his boots; hide gloves with split fingers; a scarf; the spikes strapped to his boots are of black iron and bite into the ice, leaving small shining pits. Hands and objects: the hand extended is rope-hard; a pilgrim's bead string worn smooth on his wrist; a short ice axe at his belt. Background: a blue ice stair, a drop, thin cloud; the rope round his waist runs behind him down the stair into the blue; his bead string is made of dark seeds smoothed to a polish and has a single bone bead at the knot. Light: cold light from the upper left. Expression: cautious, honest and quiet.

people.imagined: At Hòe Âm, sitting with a purse that clinks; neat sideburns; planning a toll.
people.subject: The moment: at Hòe Âm, he sits comfortably at a table, drops a heavy purse so it clinks, and smiles at the viewer, planning a toll. Face: a neat, smug face of twenty-five; trimmed clan sideburns; sleek eyes; a smile that does not reach them; smooth skin; the purse is of dark green leather fastened with a gilt clasp and a few copper coins escape from its mouth. Hair: black, combed back with oil. Body: medium, tidy, sitting back. Clothing: better forest-brown leathers than the others, a fine linen shirt, a neat belt with a fat purse; clean boots; a clan seal-ring on one finger; his boots are new and glossy, kept up on a stool; his sleeves are of fine blue-grey linen with a neat cuff; behind him a salt carter's yellow coat is just visible at the door, and a half-eaten honey cake rests on the table. Hands and objects: a fat leather purse pressed in his hand; fingers drumming; a folded page (no writing) tucked in his sleeve; the clan seal-ring, a small square of white jade, catches the lamp as his fingers drum. Background: a lodge table, a lamp; his sideburns are trimmed into sharp clan points. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Expression: greedy, deceitful and ambitious.

people.imagined: Taller than the lodge doorway, ducking under the lintel with one plank too many on his shoulder, counting on his fingers.
people.subject: The moment: taller than the lodge doorway, he ducks under the lintel with one plank too many on his shoulder, counting on his fingers and looking down at the viewer. Face: a huge, round, gentle, simple face of twenty; small kind eyes; a wide smile; big jaw; a bit of sawdust on the cheek; a brown mushroom basket hangs from his belt on a rope. Hair: brown, shaggy; his hair brushes the log ceiling and a few cobwebs trail from it. Body: enormous, taller than any door, broad. Clothing: clean brown leathers, a wide quilted jerkin; a rope belt; boots the size of loaves. Hands and objects: a stack of planks on his left shoulder; the right hand with fingers held up, stuck at ten; his hands are the size of shovels, with a scatter of splinters. Background: a log lodge doorway; the planks are rough and pale, the topmost one a plank too many that he has not noticed; the lintel above him is scored with a dozen pale lines where his head has struck it; two hunters in the yard behind him look up and laugh kindly. Light: warm daylight from the upper left. Expression: content, loyal and simple.

people.imagined: Silver dust in his hair; ears stick out; he holds a coin in his fist behind his back.
people.subject: The moment: silver dust in his hair; ears stick out; he stands with one fist hidden behind his back and looks suspiciously at the viewer. Face: a narrow, wary face of eighteen; ears sticking out; small dark eyes; thin lips; his chin is tucked down and his eyes flick sideways as if to check who is near. Hair: dark hair full of faint silver dust; a faint glitter of silver dust lies on his dark hair and on his thin shoulders like frost. Body: small, thin; he stands with his weight on one leg. Clothing: forest-brown leathers, a quilted jerkin; his tunic is a size too big, the cuffs folded back twice; his boots are worn at the toe, and his shadow is long and thin against the pale log wall. Hands and objects: the visible hand points; the other behind hides a coin; the hand behind his back is a closed fist, and a single tarnished silver coin shows between two fingers; his short sword is a plain practice blade with a wooden hilt wrapped in rag, held in its sheath at his hip. Background: a log wall; his ears are large and stand out red at the tips; a dark smudge of mine soot runs under one ear. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: diligent, callous and paranoid.

people.imagined: Cheerful as a shopfront at Hòe Âm, tapping the map tube on his back.
people.subject: The moment: cheerful as a shopfront at Hòe Âm, he taps the long tube slung over his shoulder and smiles at the viewer. Face: a bright, genial, good-looking face of thirty-two; a wide smile; warm brown eyes; a neat moustache; his jerkin is a bright saffron quilt with neat stitching, kept very clean; his smile shows even teeth and his hand lifts the tube's cap slightly as if to offer a look; a narrow strip of paper (no writing) pokes from the tube's mouth; his teeth flash white and the afternoon sun glints from the brass cap and his button. Hair: brown, smart, a leather thong. Body: medium and jaunty. Clothing: well-kept leathers, a bright quilted jerkin; his boots are polished; a small round silver coin dangles from a cord at his belt. Hands and objects: a long leather map tube slung over the back, tapped with one hand; behind him, market stalls with striped awnings and a crowd of buyers are blurred in bright sun, and a boy holds a copy toward a trader. Background: a market street; the long leather map tube has a brass cap and a strap worn shiny; a second tube peeps from the pack beneath it. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: calm, pragmatic and charming.

people.imagined: The abbess's long jaw on a boy's face; he is among the hunters, listening patiently.
people.subject: The moment: sitting among the lodge men and listening, with the abbess's long jaw on a boy's face, he looks at the viewer with open good humour. Face: a long jaw on a young face of twenty-one; trusting wide eyes; a gentle smile; the abbess's long, strong jaw makes his face look older than it is, and the other hunters' sleeves and elbows crowd close to his; a lamp throws a gentle yellow light on his cheek and he tilts his head slightly as if hearing an argument and weighing it fairly. Hair: black, neat; his hair is tied back with a plain dark ribbon and his cheeks are lightly flushed from the lodge fire. Body: slim, upright; he sits with straight shoulders, like a boy taught manners young. Clothing: clean forest-brown leathers, a fine gentry linen collar; his collar is of pale gentry linen trimmed with a narrow blue line. Hands and objects: hands loosely folded; his hands are clean with well-kept nails, and he has a faint ink stain on the left forefinger; a tin cup of tea is steaming at his elbow, set there by a teasing hunter. Background: a lodge interior. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: honest, forgiving and trusting.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the hunter who ran from the sealed cave: a single white eyebrow singed by cold light.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like old silk, of the hunter who ran from the sealed cave: a short, wiry hunter looks back over his shoulder at the viewer, his feet set as if about to turn and run. Face: a wiry, cautious face of thirty-five with one white eyebrow above the left eye, a single streak of pale paint where the cave's cold light singed it, the other brow dark; eyes narrowed against the glare with small wrinkles fanning at the corners; the mouth a thin line. Hair: dark, tied back. Body: short and wiry, a tied bundle of hunting snares hanging on his back. Clothing: a hunter's leather jerkin, cracked with age and stitched with sinew, a rope round the waist, leather trousers and soft boots. Hands and objects: a short hunting knife held low in one hand. Background: the cave mouth a jagged black hole in a grey rock face, a thin line of cold blue-white light seeping from a crack beside it and throwing a pale edge on his shoulder; the faded silk shows a vertical crease down its middle and brown spots at the corners. Light: faded and yellowed like old pigment, with a cool pale rim on the near shoulder. Expression: a wary, narrowed, stubborn look, the lips pressed thin, a man who has seen something in the dark and will not say what.
